root_idea.summary: A semantic center of loose, degraded, scattered, or worthless material, especially refuse and scum borne on water.
root_idea.development: The noun غثاء denotes water-borne refuse and decayed plant residue. Classical verbal uses extend this imagery to filling or sweeping together, while also recording separate applications to confusion, matting, clouding, nausea, poor quality, striking, and abundance.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The group is a Quran-attested nominal with a stable classical citation form and two materially distinct Quranic applications.

senses.definition: Rubbish, scum, and broken or decayed plant matter borne on water or left as dry residue.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, it describes refuse carried by a torrent and dried plant residue or stubble; the two contexts represent the same lexical field of loose, degraded matter.

senses.definition: By metaphor, something rendered worthless, swept away, or of no account.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran applies the image to a people reduced to refuse. The same figurative construction can compare property, work, or effort with something lacking value.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a valley or watercourse: to become full of refuse, including dung, leaves, and reeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I construction; variant forms are also reported in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of meat: to be poor or bad because of leanness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A description of the meat's deficient quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the soul or stomach: to become nauseated or foul, heaving toward vomiting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical discussion also records the related nouns غَثَيَانٌ and غَثْيٌ for this agitated, vomiting tendency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the sky: to become covered or clouded with clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may also indicate that clouding has begun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a torrent: to sweep the pasture together and deprive it of its freshness or sweetness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction describing the torrent's damaging action on pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix speech or language together confusedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the action of gathering or mixing; variant verbal patterns are reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beat or strike, dealing blows among cattle or people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence attests the expression with cattle and people as its objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land: to become abundant in herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe the onset of becoming rich in vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of hair: to become matted or compacted together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use is reported as a possible dialectal variant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The scum or foam of a cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the Quranic imagery of torrent-borne refuse and dry vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lowly, vile, or refuse portion of mankind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative expression for people regarded as socially contemptible; it is kept separate from the Quranic application of the physical refuse image.
A separate unclassified nominal entry, not a variant of the Quranic noun غُثَاء.
